properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destination-illegal-chars-regex
properties.description: Configure regex expression to use for replacement of illegal characters in the destination names. Default is [\t\s*#:]

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destination-illegal-chars-replacement
properties.description: Configure replacement character for illegal characters in the destination names. Default is -

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destination-prefix
properties.description: Set destination prefix to use to build destinations, i.e. prefix_destination. Default is empty string.

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destination-separator
properties.description: Set destination separator to use to build full destinations, i.e. prefix_destination. Default is _

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destination-transformers
properties.description: Configure list of transformer functions for destination

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destination-transformers-enabled
properties.description: Enable destination name transformers to apply conversion to all destination name for producers, consumers and connectors

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.destinations
properties.description: Configure destination properties to apply customization to producers and consumer channel bindings with matching destination key.

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.instance-index
properties.description: Configure consumer instance index for partitioned messaging. Default is 0

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.partition-count
properties.description: Set partition count for partitioned mode. Default is 1

properties.name: activiti.cloud.messaging.partitioned
properties.description: Enable partitioned messaging configuration for engine events producer and consumers
